Welcome to The Advanced English Dictionary!
In the application settings you can activate the full search option that will allow you to search inside the definitions.
You can also activate the speech synthesizer to listen to the definitions as well as various user interface settings to improve the text readability.
If you have a problem running the app, please try reinstalling it in case there have been an error during the download. If you have any doubt, please don't hesitate to send us an email to support@movinapp.com and we will gladly help you solve any question regarding the app.
